newsitem.title: USA: Detroit Ed now sees Fermi nuke restart Fri.
newsitem.headline: Detroit Ed now sees Fermi nuke restart Fri.

text.p: Restart of the 1,116 megawatt (MW) Fermi 2 nuclear generating station was pushed back to Friday from Thursday because work was needed on a monitoring system, Detroit Edison Co said Friday.
"We're shooting for later today. We're recalibrating the oxygen-hydrogen monitor," a company spokesman said.
Fermi 2 was manually shut Tuesday to repair a drywell vacuum breaker that failed to close during a startup attempt earlier this week.
The Newport, Michigan, power plant was taken off line September 27 for refueling and maintenance.
Detroit Edison, which owns and operates Fermi 2, is a subsidiary of DTE Energy Corp.
